input.title: Model Input
input.summary: The local AI Check context assembled by the extension before calling the provider.

fields.meaning: The blocked target the user is trying to open.
fields.whyNecessary: The model needs to know which site or URL the user is asking to access.
fields.productImpact: Anchors the decision in the current blocked target.
fields.validation: Derived from the local blocked target record.
fields.commonMistakes: Treating the target as a generic category instead of the concrete blocked target.

fields.meaning: The active strictness level for the AI Check.
fields.whyNecessary: Strictness changes unlock caps, cooldown ranges, and how much certainty is required.
fields.productImpact: Changes decision thresholds and cooldown timing.
fields.validation: Must be one of the configured strictness levels.
fields.commonMistakes: Evaluating a case without checking which strictness level applies.

fields.meaning: How many assistant turns happened before this model response.
fields.whyNecessary: The model needs to know whether it can still ask follow-up questions.
fields.productImpact: Controls when ASK_MORE is still allowed.
fields.validation: Derived from the local session state.
fields.commonMistakes: Counting user messages instead of assistant turns.

fields.meaning: Maximum assistant turns allowed in this AI Check.
fields.whyNecessary: The model needs a bounded conversation limit.
fields.productImpact: Prevents endless back-and-forth before enforcement.
fields.validation: Derived from the AI Check session policy.
fields.commonMistakes: Allowing ASK_MORE after the final turn.

fields.meaning: Whether this response is the final allowed assistant turn.
fields.whyNecessary: Final turns must enforce ALLOW, AI_COOLDOWN, or BLOCK instead of ASK_MORE.
fields.productImpact: Changes the allowed decision set for this turn.
fields.validation: Derived from assistantTurnCount and maxAssistantTurns.
fields.commonMistakes: Returning ASK_MORE when this flag is true.

example.content: I just want one quick video.

fields.meaning: The user-visible AI Check conversation so far.
fields.whyNecessary: The model must evaluate the user's stated reason and prior assistant prompts.
fields.productImpact: Determines whether the request is specific, bounded, repeated, or vague.
fields.validation: System messages are excluded before sending to the provider.
fields.commonMistakes: Judging only the latest message when earlier turns contain missing context.

fields.meaning: Relevant local pattern memory for this target.
fields.whyNecessary: The model needs long-term behavior context separate from same-session repetition.
fields.productImpact: Can shift vague repeated behavior toward AI_COOLDOWN or BLOCK.
fields.validation: Loaded locally and limited before the provider request.
fields.commonMistakes: Treating same-session repetition as long-term memory without evidence.

messages.content: You're trying to open youtube.com. What are you here to do, and why now?
I just want one quick video.

output.title: Model Output
output.summary: The JSON object the provider must return for every AI Check decision.
output.schemaSummary: { decision, userFacingMessage, decisionReasonCategory, unlockMinutes, aiCooldownSeconds, nextQuestion, scores: { repeatedReason, impulse, deliberateness }, memoryUpdate: { behaviorReasonCategory, patternNote } }

fields.meaning: The enforcement outcome for the current AI Check turn.
fields.whyNecessary: The extension needs one explicit outcome to derive temporary unlocks, AI cooldowns, follow-up questions, or block holds.
fields.productImpact: Directly controls whether the target opens, pauses, asks for more detail, or stays blocked.
fields.validation: Must be one of the four known decision values.
fields.commonMistakes: Using free-text decisions or returning ASK_MORE on the final turn.

fields.example: What specific task do you need YouTube for, and when will you stop?
fields.meaning: The calm explanation shown to the user after the decision.
fields.whyNecessary: The user needs to understand the decision without seeing internal scoring or rubric labels.
fields.productImpact: Sets tone, trust, and clarity in the block page conversation.
fields.validation: Falls back to a generic ask-more message only when missing.
fields.commonMistakes: Shaming the user, overexplaining policy, or omitting the concrete next action.

fields.meaning: The reason category for this specific decision.
fields.whyNecessary: PM Review and evals need a stable reason label separate from long-term behavior memory.
fields.productImpact: Explains false allows, false blocks, and strictness behavior in review.
fields.validation: Unknown labels are normalized where possible, otherwise default from decision.
fields.commonMistakes: Putting behavior-memory categories such as stress or habit in this field.

fields.meaning: Temporary access duration when the decision is ALLOW.
fields.whyNecessary: ALLOW must produce a bounded unlock instead of permanent access.
fields.productImpact: Creates the temporary unlock window and caps it by strictness.
fields.validation: Required for ALLOW and must be within the strictness cap.
fields.commonMistakes: Returning null for ALLOW or a duration above the strictness limit.

fields.meaning: Pause duration when the decision is AI_COOLDOWN.
fields.whyNecessary: AI cooldown is separate from allow and block; it needs its own timer.
fields.productImpact: Controls the in-chat cooldown period before the user can continue the AI Check.
fields.validation: Required for AI_COOLDOWN and normalized to a sane strictness-derived range.
fields.commonMistakes: Using legacy delay fields or returning cooldown seconds for non-cooldown decisions.

fields.example: What specific task do you need YouTube for, and when will you stop?
fields.meaning: The follow-up question when the decision is ASK_MORE.
fields.whyNecessary: ASK_MORE must collect missing intent, time limit, or exit-plan details.
fields.productImpact: Determines the next prompt shown in the AI Check conversation.
fields.validation: Required for ASK_MORE unless the session is already on the final turn.
fields.commonMistakes: Asking vague questions or using ASK_MORE when final-turn enforcement is required.

fields.meaning: How strongly this resembles a repeated or previously remembered reason.
fields.whyNecessary: The model needs a numeric signal that can be evaluated independently from the decision label.
fields.productImpact: Helps review repeated-excuse failures and regression strictness.
fields.validation: Must be a finite number between 0 and 100; rounded to an integer.
fields.commonMistakes: Treating the three scores as percentages that must sum to 100.

fields.meaning: How impulsive or reactive the current request appears.
fields.whyNecessary: Cooldown and block decisions depend on impulse risk, especially in stricter modes.
fields.productImpact: Supports PM diagnosis of over-allow and under-ask cases.
fields.validation: Must be a finite number between 0 and 100; rounded to an integer.
fields.commonMistakes: Leaving it low for vague, emotional, or repeated requests.

fields.meaning: How specific, bounded, and intentional the user's plan appears.
fields.whyNecessary: ALLOW should be grounded in deliberate intent, not just a polite request.
fields.productImpact: Supports unlock decisions and strictness tuning.
fields.validation: Must be a finite number between 0 and 100; rounded to an integer.
fields.commonMistakes: Overrating generic phrases like one quick video without a stop condition.

fields.type: stress | boredom | loneliness | escape | habit | intentional | other
fields.meaning: The long-term behavior pattern category to remember for the target.
fields.whyNecessary: Pattern memory needs behavior labels that stay separate from current decision reasoning.
fields.productImpact: Affects future repeated-pattern context and PM review of remembered behavior.
fields.validation: Unknown labels are normalized where possible and otherwise become other.
fields.commonMistakes: Using decision reason labels such as insufficient_reason here.

fields.example: User tends to request vague short video breaks without a clear stop condition.
fields.meaning: Optional short note about the repeated behavior pattern.
fields.whyNecessary: The model can preserve useful behavioral context without storing unnecessary transcript detail.
fields.productImpact: Improves future AI Check context while keeping local memory concise.
fields.validation: Empty strings become null.
fields.commonMistakes: Including sensitive or overly detailed personal content when a short pattern note is enough.

example.userFacingMessage: What specific task do you need YouTube for, and when will you stop?
example.nextQuestion: What specific task do you need YouTube for, and when will you stop?

memoryUpdate.patternNote: User tends to request vague short video breaks without a clear stop condition.

evaluation.title: Evaluation Case
evaluation.summary: The unified case fixture used to run model regression checks.

fields.meaning: The model input context used for this case.
fields.whyNecessary: Evaluation must replay a concrete checkpoint context.
fields.productImpact: Determines what the model sees during the eval.
fields.validation: Must match the input contract.
fields.commonMistakes: Writing assertions without preserving the original target, strictness, or messages.

fields.meaning: Optional captured provider output for inspection.
fields.whyNecessary: Stored outputs help compare provider behavior across runs.
fields.productImpact: Improves PM review traceability.
fields.validation: When present, should match the output contract.
fields.commonMistakes: Treating captured output as the expected assertion.

fields.meaning: The expected decision for this case.
fields.whyNecessary: Every eval case needs one primary pass/fail decision assertion.
fields.productImpact: Determines the core regression result.
fields.validation: Must be a valid decision.
fields.commonMistakes: Using tags as a substitute for expected decision.

fields.meaning: Phrases or topics that must appear in the user-facing message.
fields.whyNecessary: Some ASK_MORE cases need specific missing information.
fields.productImpact: Catches vague follow-up questions.
fields.validation: Each phrase is matched case-insensitively against userFacingMessage.
fields.commonMistakes: Making this too specific to one exact wording.

fields.meaning: Phrases that must not appear in the user-facing message.
fields.whyNecessary: Tone and safety regressions need explicit negative assertions.
fields.productImpact: Prevents shame, moral judgment, or unsafe wording.
fields.validation: Each phrase is matched case-insensitively against userFacingMessage.
fields.commonMistakes: Using broad words that would fail harmless messages.

fields.meaning: Risk and category labels for filtering eval results.
fields.whyNecessary: PM Review and eval reporting need grouped risk views.
fields.productImpact: Drives case sets and tag-level pass rates.
fields.validation: Must be an array; recommended tags are shared in PM Review.
fields.commonMistakes: Using tags to encode expected behavior instead of assertions.
